payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to develop per-triple templates, including hand-crafted templates for predicates and the transformation of triples into facts using these templates.

claims.text: Per-triple templates were developed using hand-crafted templates for each predicate, transforming triples into facts.
The templates were designed to introduce in-domain knowledge about the semantics of individual predicates.
The approach minimizes manual workload while controlling the quality of input for subsequent processing steps.
